blocks.content:
Citizens must:
• Abide by the Constitution and respect its ideals.
• Respect the National Flag and National Anthem.
• Uphold unity and integrity of India.
• Defend the country.
• Promote harmony.
• Protect environment.
• Develop scientific temper.
• Safeguard public property.
• Strive for excellence.
• Provide opportunities for education to children.
Uphold unity and integrity of India.

items: Article 51A deals directly with the Fundamental Duties prescribed for citizens of India.
Promoting harmony, developing a scientific temper, and safeguarding public property are high-frequency tested duties.
Providing opportunities for education to children is explicitly listed under Article 51A duties.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Citizens must respect the Constitution, its ideals, the National Flag, and the National Anthem.
It is the duty of every citizen to uphold and protect the unity and integrity of India and defend the nation.
Citizens are expected to promote harmony, protect the natural environment, and develop a scientific temper.
Safeguarding public property, striving for excellence, and providing education opportunities for children are mandatory responsibilities.
